spec.description: Which log events happen and which statements are slow, from the server log grouped by message pattern. Needs log parsing enabled on the source.

spec.title: Log records
spec.description: Records of the selected severities per interval, averaged over the time range.

spec.expr: avg_over_time((sum((pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", severity=~"$severity", database=~"$database|"} and timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", severity=~"$severity", database=~"$database|"}) == on (dbname) group_left () max by (dbname) (timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname"})))) or vector(0))[$__range:])

spec.title: ERROR, FATAL and PANIC records
spec.description: Records of the three error severities per interval, averaged over the time range, whatever the selector says.

spec.expr: avg_over_time((sum((pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", severity=~"(error|fatal|panic)", database=~"$database|"} and timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", severity=~"(error|fatal|panic)", database=~"$database|"}) == on (dbname) group_left () max by (dbname) (timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname"})))) or vector(0))[$__range:])

spec.title: Distinct patterns
spec.description: Distinct message patterns seen in the time range, not counting 'other'.

spec.title: Records in 'other'
spec.description: Share of records that fell beyond the 100 patterns kept per severity and interval. High values mean the tables below hide a long tail.

spec.expr: 100 * (avg_over_time((sum((pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", severity=~"$severity", database=~"$database|", pattern_id="other"} and timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", severity=~"$severity", database=~"$database|", pattern_id="other"}) == on (dbname) group_left () max by (dbname) (timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname"})))) or vector(0))[$__range:]) / clamp_min(avg_over_time((sum((pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", severity=~"$severity", database=~"$database|"} and timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", severity=~"$severity", database=~"$database|"}) == on (dbname) group_left () max by (dbname) (timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname"})))))[$__range:]), 1))

spec.title: Log records per severity
spec.description: How many log records the server wrote, per interval and severity, across every database of the instance.

spec.expr: sum by (severity) ((pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", severity=~"$severity", database=~"$database|"} and timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", severity=~"$severity", database=~"$database|"}) == on (dbname) group_left () max by (dbname) (timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname"}))))

spec.title: Top patterns
spec.description: The log events that happened most. Click a pattern id to follow it over time. 'other' is the long tail beyond the 100 patterns kept per severity and interval. Message text is available with the Postgres sink only.

spec.expr: topk(50, avg_over_time((sum by (pattern_id, severity, sqlstate, database) ((pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", severity=~"$severity", database=~"$database|"} and timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", severity=~"$severity", database=~"$database|"}) == on (dbname) group_left () max by (dbname) (timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname"})))))[$__range:]))

spec.title: Slowest patterns
spec.description: Statements and other events that logged a duration, ranked by total time. Needs log_min_duration_statement or auto_explain on the server.

spec.expr: topk(20, avg_over_time((sum by (pattern_id, database) ((pgwatch_server_log_patterns_duration_sum_ms{dbname=~"$dbname", database=~"$database|"} and timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_duration_sum_ms{dbname=~"$dbname", database=~"$database|"}) == on (dbname) group_left () max by (dbname) (timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname"})))))[$__range:]))

avg_over_time((sum by (pattern_id, database) ((pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", database=~"$database|"} and timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", database=~"$database|"}) == on (dbname) group_left () max by (dbname) (timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname"}))) and (pgwatch_server_log_patterns_duration_sum_ms and timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_duration_sum_ms) == on (dbname) group_left () max by (dbname) (timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname"})))))[$__range:])

avg_over_time((sum by (pattern_id, database) ((pgwatch_server_log_patterns_duration_sum_ms{dbname=~"$dbname", database=~"$database|"} and timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_duration_sum_ms{dbname=~"$dbname", database=~"$database|"}) == on (dbname) group_left () max by (dbname) (timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname"})))))[$__range:]) / clamp_min(avg_over_time((sum by (pattern_id, database) ((pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", database=~"$database|"} and timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", database=~"$database|"}) == on (dbname) group_left () max by (dbname) (timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname"}))) and (pgwatch_server_log_patterns_duration_sum_ms and timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_duration_sum_ms) == on (dbname) group_left () max by (dbname) (timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname"})))))[$__range:]), 1)

max_over_time((max by (pattern_id, database) ((pgwatch_server_log_patterns_duration_max_ms{dbname=~"$dbname", database=~"$database|"} and timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_duration_max_ms{dbname=~"$dbname", database=~"$database|"}) == on (dbname) group_left () max by (dbname) (timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname"})))))[$__range:])

spec.title: Selected pattern over time
spec.description: How often pattern $pattern_id occurred per interval, split by database. Pick a pattern in the tables above.

spec.expr: sum by (database) ((pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", pattern_id="$pattern_id"} and timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname", pattern_id="$pattern_id"}) == on (dbname) group_left () max by (dbname) (timestamp(pgwatch_server_log_patterns_count{dbname=~"$dbname"}))))

options.content:
Click a pattern id in **Top patterns** or **Slowest patterns** to select it.

Selected pattern id: $pattern_id

The message template is stored only by the Postgres sink; the Prometheus sink exposes the pattern id and the counts.
